assets.prompt: Use case: illustration-story. Asset type: production background for a children's brain-training mobile game, portrait 1024x1536. Primary request: a joyful polished flat picture-book meadow scene matching a premium preschool learning game: bright cyan-blue sky, fluffy soft white clouds, layered mint and apple-green rounded hills, a sunny lime grass clearing, bushes and a few small yellow/white flowers along the edges, cozy rounded trees at the very far left and right. Composition: top 70 percent is mostly clean open sky with subtle clouds near edges; bottom 30 percent grassy ground, foreground side bushes; quiet readable empty center for real HTML game UI. View straight on, not top down. Crisp simple shapes, candy colors, very slight soft gradient shading and friendly thick rounded edges. Palette sky #71d8f7, cream #fff4d5, grass #b8df60, leaves #59b873. The center remains clean and bright. Constraints: absolutely no text, letters, numbers, signs, boards, panels, buttons, game objects, checkerboards, toys, people, animals, frames, watermarks, logos. This is scenery only, not a screenshot or mockup.
